status_notes: supersedes the prior statement, which used justification vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path (imprecise: that asserts the code is PRESENT but unreachable). Correct basis is component_not_present, and it is structurally provable: `cargo tree -i yaml-rust --edges normal` returns "nothing to print" — no normal-edge path exists; the only path is yaml-rust <- serde_yaml <- insta [dev-dependencies] <- cargo-vet, and cargo never links dev-dependencies into a release binary. ALSO CORRECTS an inaccurate claim in the prior statement: tool binaries are built with `cargo install`, NOT `cargo auditable build`, so they carry no embedded dependency data — `cargo audit bin` on cargo-vet.exe warns the report is incomplete (81 of ~183 deps recovered by heuristic). That run corroborates absence (yaml-rust/serde_yaml/insta: 0 hits, 0 findings) but is NOT the proof; the cargo dependency-graph structure is.
author: bgonz808
